summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. and Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation, reporting first-quarter 2026 earnings results. The press release details funds from operations of $0.90 per unit (up 10% YoY), mentions strategic initiatives such as a new equipment leasing platform and a Bloom Energy partnership, and notes $1 billion of capital recycling proceeds secured. There is no transaction, no acquisition or divestiture, no activist campaign, no tender offer, and no special-situation event. This is a routine earnings report. The registrants are foreign private issuers filing a 6-K, which is the equivalent of an 8-K for non-US companies, but the content is purely operational and financial results.
